rights.pageSubtitle: Fahamka xuquuqdaada dustuuriga ah inta lagu jiro kulamo la hay fulinta sharciga socdaalka
rights.disclaimerText: Macluumaadkan waa ujeeddo waxbarasho oo kaliya mana aha talo sharci. Xaalad kasta way kala duwan tahay. Talo ku saabsan xaaladaada gaarka ah, fadlan la tashii qareen u qalma arrimaha socdaalka.
rights.rightSilentDesc: Kuma qasabana inaad ka jawaabto su'aalaha ku saabsan meesha aad ku dhashay, xaaladda socdaalkaaga, ama sida aad ugu soo gashay Mareykanka.
rights.rightAttorneyDesc: Waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad la hadashid qareenna ka hor intaadan jawaab ka bixin su'aalo kasta. Haddii la xidho, waxaad sameysan kartaa wicitaanno telefon.
rights.rightAttorneyPhrase: Dheh: "Waxaan rabaa inaan la hadlo qareen."
rights.rightNoSignDesc: Ha saxiixin wax kasta oo aadan la hadlin qareen. Saxiixida "ka bixitaanka ikhtiyaariga ah" waxy kaa qaadi kartaa xaqa dhageysiga.
rights.rightNoSignPhrase: Dheh: "Ma rabi inaan wax saxiixo ilaa aan la hadlo qareenka."
rights.rightNoLieDesc: Weligaa ha bixin macluumaad been ah ama dukumiintiyada been ah. Taasi waxay keeni kartaa dacwado dembi iyo caqabad mustaqbalka caawimada socdaalka.
rights.rightNoLiePhrase: Iska aamus halkii aad jawaabyo been ah ku sameysan lahayd.
rights.warrantTitle: Amar Maxkamad dhexe iyo Amar Maamul
rights.warrantSubtitle: Fahamka farqiga ayaa ilaali kara xuquuqdaada. Kaliya amar MAXKAMAD ayaa ogolaanaya gelitaanka gurigaaga.
rights.detainedTitle: Haddii Adiga ama Mid aad Jeceshahay la Xidho
rights.detainedSubtitle: Tillaabooyinka muhiimka ah ee markiiba la qaado
rights.consularText: Hoos yimaada Heshiiska Vienna, haddii la xidho, waxaad xaq u leedahay inaad la xiriirto qunsuliyaddda wadankaaga.
rights.consularPhrase: Dheh: "Waxaan rabaa inaan la xiriiro qunsuliyaddayda."

about.title: Sida ICEwhistle u shaqeeyo
about.subtitle: Hufnaanta & Sirta
about.tagline: Akoon ma leh. La socodsiinta ma leh. Goobta waa loo wareejiyaa sirta daruufteeda.
about.taglineDesc: ICEwhistle waxaa loo qorsheeyay in lagu ilaaliyo sirta adiga, halka bulshada la caawimayo inay warqabka ahaadaan. Waxaan soo ururinnaa xogta ugu yar ee lagama maarmaan ah, mana la socodno.
about.step1Title: Loo wareejiyaa ~500 mitir oo grid ah
about.step1Desc: Isku-duwidaada saxda ah marnaba lama kaydiyo. Waxaan u wareejinnaa 500m oo grid ah, taasoo daboolaysa qiyaastii 4-6 xaafadood oo magaalo ah.
about.step2Title: Offset aan kala sooca ah ayaa la kordhiyaa
about.step2Desc: Waxaan kordhinnaa offset aan kala sooca ah oo ah ±100m si xitaa goobta grid-ka ayan la saadaali karin. Tani waxay suuragal ka dhigaysaa in meel-marinnada saxda ah dib loo soo saaro.
about.step3Desc: Warbixintu waxay aqoonsadaa aag guud, ma aha cinwaan gaar ah. Kugama aqoonsan karo goobta warbixintaada.
about.openSourceDesc: ICEwhistle waa isha furan. Qof kastaa wuu eegi karaa code-ka si uu u xaqiijiyo sheegatashada sirta.

support.title: Taageero aaladdan
support.intro: Aaladani waa bilaash, aan xayeysiis lahayn, oo dhamaan dadka u diyaar ah.
support.mission: Waxaa loo maamuulaa sidii khayraad dadweyne ah si loo caawiyo dadka inay fahmaan xuquuqdooda, wadaagaan macluumaad waqti ku habboon, oo helaan taageero bulsho inta lagu jiro kulamo ICE. Akoon lama baahdo, xogta isticmaalka lamana raadraaco.
support.legal: Dib-u-eegis sharci iyo nuxur ah oo marmar ah
support.transparency: Wax-ku-biiriyayaasha waxa laga yaabaa inay helaan mushaharo yar oo loogu talagalay dayactirka ama hawlaha turjumaadda. Kharashaadkani si hufan ayaa loo sheegaa. Dhaqaalka dheeriga ah waxa laga yaabaa in dib loogu qaybiyo ururro bulsheed oo isku-aragtiga ah ama dadaallo is-caawin ah.
support.donationsSecure: Deeqaha waxaa si ammaan ah u hakaameya OpenCollective
support.noStoreDonorInfo: Boggan ma urursan karo ama kaydin karo macluumaadka deeqbixiyayaasha
support.accessNeverGated: Helitaanka khayraadka weligeed lama xakameeyo lacag-bixin
support.closing: Taageerida waa hal dariiqa oo lagu caawiyaa inaan aaladdan helitaan oo joogto ah u noqdo — laakiin macluumaadka halkan ku yaal weligeed waxa uu ahaan doonaa bilaash.
support.processed: Deeqaha waxaa hakaameya OpenCollective. Boggan ma maamulo lacag-bixinta mana urursan karo xogta deeqbixiyayaasha.
support.preferDirect: Ma doorataa inaad toos ugu deeqdo OpenCollective?
support.infrastructure: Deeqdaadu waxay taageertaa kaabayaasha, maaha ururinta xogta.
